services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Parties are 2 hours long. You may customize your time spent in the gym and in the party room Party includes 25 kids. If you expect more than 25 kids, there is an additional $50 coaches' fee, and each child thereafter is $20 A $100 non-refundable deposit is required to reserve your party. The deposit can be used toward a future birthday party if a party is cancelled before the 3-week policy Participating children need to wear loose, comfortable clothing. No jeans, crop tops, or
